items.title: 区分 primary truth docs 与 extracted reference docs
items.context: truth-source 决策文档已经定义 extracted 是反向提取的参考层，不该和 decisions/ 根 requirement 混成同等优先级的 uncovered_requirement 来源。

happy.desc: truth_scan 会显式标出 decisions/*.md 是 primary，而 extracted/*.md 是 derived/reference，后续消费者能稳定区分两层来源。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/derived-truth-gap.json:1 WHY CHK-001 happy: truth_scan marks primary and derived tiers is covered by the derived-truth regression fixture. severity=info

edge.desc: 完整 truth_scan 仍保留 extracted 的条目与 summary 统计，不会因为区分层级而把参考层彻底扫掉。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/derived-truth-gap.json:1 WHY CHK-001 edge: truth_scan summary still keeps derived topics is covered by the derived-truth regression fixture. severity=info

adversarial.desc: 如果 source tier 语义仍然缺失，gap_analyze 只能继续靠路径硬编码或把 extracted 当 primary，测试应直接暴露这一点。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/derived-truth-gap.json:1 WHY CHK-001 adversarial: missing source tier semantics would break derived filtering is covered by the derived-truth regression fixture. severity=info

items.title: 让 gap_analyze 的 uncovered_requirement 只对 primary truth 生效
items.context: summary 可以继续统计 extracted，但 high gap 判断不能再把 derived docs 当成主真相源，否则会持续产生假高优先级 backlog。

happy.desc: gap_analyze 输出的 uncovered_requirement/high gap 只来自 primary truth，source.file=extracted/*.md 的 derived requirement 不再计入 high。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/derived-truth-gap.json:1 WHY CHK-002 happy: gap_analyze no longer raises high gaps from extracted docs is covered by the derived-truth regression fixture. severity=info

edge.desc: 同一次分析里 decisions/*.md 的真实 requirement gap 仍然保留在 high 列表中，不会被 derived 过滤误伤。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/derived-truth-gap.json:1 WHY CHK-002 edge: primary decisions still produce real high requirement gaps is covered by the derived-truth regression fixture. severity=info

adversarial.desc: 如果实现只是简单忽略所有 requirement 或把 derived 与 primary 一起降级，测试会看到真正的 decisions requirement 也消失。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/derived-truth-gap.json:1 WHY CHK-002 adversarial: derived filtering does not erase all requirement gaps is covered by the derived-truth regression fixture. severity=info

items.title: 补回归验证，锁住 extracted 不再制造 high requirement 误报
items.context: 至少覆盖 decisions/*.md 仍会产出 requirement gap，而 extracted/*.md 只保留参考/覆盖展示，不再直接生成 high uncovered_requirement。

happy.desc: 回归脚本会同时断言 decisions requirement 仍计入 high uncovered_requirement，而 extracted requirement 只保留参考层，不再拉高 high gap。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/derived-truth-gap.json:1 WHY CHK-003 happy: verifier script locks primary-vs-derived gap behavior is covered by the derived-truth regression fixture. severity=info

edge.desc: truth_scan summary 仍能看到 extracted topic/统计，说明参考层没有被误删。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/derived-truth-gap.json:1 WHY CHK-003 edge: verifier keeps derived summary visibility under test is covered by the derived-truth regression fixture. severity=info

adversarial.desc: 如果未来有人再次把 extracted 当 primary，回归会重新出现 source.file=extracted/*.md 的 high gap，而不是静默放过。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/derived-truth-gap.json:1 WHY CHK-003 adversarial: verifier would fail if extracted became high again is covered by the derived-truth regression fixture. severity=info
